app.name: KeyEd
app.storageError: Your progress could not be saved. Lessons still work, but results will be lost when you close the app.

home.title: Learn to touch type
home.intro: Short lessons adapt to you: new keys open once you have mastered the previous ones.

how.start: You start with two keys under your index fingers: {{keys}}.
how.unlock: A new key opens when you type the open ones fast and accurately.
how.focus: Lessons give more practice to the keys that are hardest for you.

home.allOpen: All letters are open. Keep practising: {{keys}}.

newKey.hint: Keep your fingers on the home row and reach with one finger only. Return it to its place after each press.

practice.readyHint: Start typing: the timer starts with the first key.
practice.pausedHint: Press any key to continue. Esc leaves the lesson.

wrongLayout.en-us-qwerty: Switch the system keyboard layout to English
wrongLayout.ru-jcuken: Switch the system keyboard layout to Russian

result.title: Lesson complete
result.unlockedHint: The next lesson starts with a short introduction.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.empty: Finish a lesson to see your statistics.
stats.heatHint: Point at a key to see its details.

settings.title: Settings
settings.layoutHint: Each layout has its own progress and statistics.

strict.label: Strict mode
strict.hint: A new key opens only when every open key is fast and accurate right now. Without it, a key mastered once no longer holds you back.

speedUnit.label: Speed unit
speedUnit.hint: Automatic shows characters per minute for Russian and words per minute for English.

inputMode.label: Input
inputMode.emulateHint: The letter is taken from the key you press, so a Russian lesson works even with the English layout on.
inputMode.systemHint: The letter comes from the system keyboard layout. Switch it to the lesson's layout before typing.

goal.label: Daily goal
goal.hint: Minutes of typing a day. Only typing time counts, not pauses.

reminders.label: Remind me
reminders.hint: A system notification at this time if today’s goal is not reached yet. KeyEd must be running, for example minimised.
reminders.denied: Notifications are not allowed. Allow them for KeyEd in the system settings.

goal.label: Daily goal
goal.left_one: {{count}} minute left to the daily goal
goal.left_other: {{count}} minutes left to the daily goal

streak.none: No streak yet: reach today’s goal to start one.
streak.broken_one: The streak has ended. Your best was {{count}} day — start a new one today.
streak.broken_other: The streak has ended. Your best was {{count}} days — start a new one today.
streak.freezesHint: A freeze keeps the streak when you miss a day. You get one for every 7 days in a row, and can keep two.

week.title: Last 7 days
week.noData: No lessons in the last 7 days.

calendar.title: Activity
calendar.hint: Point at a day to see its practice.

home-row.name: Home position
home-row.condition: Master the keys of the first lessons

halfway.name: Halfway
halfway.condition: Open half the letters of a layout

alphabet.name: The whole alphabet
alphabet.condition: Master every letter of a layout

speed.name: Picking up speed
speed.condition: A lesson at {{value}} characters per minute

flawless.name: Flawless
flawless.condition: A lesson without a single mistake

steady-hand.name: Steady hand
steady-hand.condition: Lessons in a row with 97% accuracy or more: {{value}}

streak.name: Streak
streak.condition: Days in a row with the daily goal reached: {{value}}

two-layouts.name: Two layouts
two-layouts.condition: Master the keys of the first lessons in a second layout
